claim: Two days later, last Friday, a stranger arrived at Kirk’s debris-laden front lawn in Wyandotte County, and said he’d be back in 30 minutes with a tarp, some lumber, and a crew to cover up the maple-shaped gash in Kirk’s house.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: KCTV5, 3 Oct 2026 22:12 CDT (Wyandotte County, Kan.): 'On Friday, a stranger walked into his yard and made him a promise': 'I'll be back in about thirty minutes and we'll get some material and tarp and a crew'; he came back 'with a load of lumber'. Lumber was brought, not promised by name - within the claim.
